title: Illuminated Spotify installation
slide_intent: Place identity where people gather because recognition can come from an encounter with a space as well as a printed mark.
strategic_value: Spotify can connect its name to live music culture through luminous signage beside a performer.
demonstration: A person in a cap stands beside a magenta-lit structure with a glowing Spotify lockup and cyan edges.
practical_value: Compare the visibility of a luminous mark with the color atmosphere around it.

content_islands.spec: The figure fills the lower-left area and provides scale.

content_islands.spec: The upper-right Spotify sign and horizontal neon edges establish the branded setting.
